Interactive Brokers new entrant competitive threat brokerage 2026

findings.claim: IBKR 2026年6月客戶 DARTs 526.9萬，年增53%、月增6%；客戶帳戶約518–519萬，年增約34%
findings.source: Finance Magnates / ChartMill, Interactive Brokers June 2026 DARTs
findings.excerpt: Total client DARTs in June were 5,269,000, representing a 53% increase from June 2025 and a 6% rise from May 2026.

findings.claim: IBKR 2026年7月客戶帳戶達531.7萬，年增34%；DARTs 442.6萬，年增27%、月減16%
findings.source: FX News Group, Interactive Brokers registers 27% Y/Y increase in DARTs in July 2026

findings.claim: IBKR FY2025 10-K 稱預期直接市場接取經紀業務競爭將持續加劇，競爭者含自建電子交易工具的 prime broker 及線上股票、選擇權／期貨經紀商
findings.excerpt: We expect competition to continue and intensify in the future.

findings.claim: Motley Fool 評論：威脅屬漸進；大型既有業者價格競爭，零售平台簡化開戶；若用戶改重 AI 洞察與介面，競爭焦點可能轉向使用者體驗；未指出特定新進入者
findings.source: Motley Fool, Can Interactive Brokers Maintain Its Edge in a Changing Brokerage Industry?

competitive_share_entrants.note: 未找到與 Schwab／Robinhood 的明確份額比較數字，亦未找到特定新進入者；僅下2次搜尋。excerpt 僅第1、3條為逐字。
